content_sections.body: Start with the model: 'Let's meet outside the community centre at half past six.' Replace one detail with your own information about arranging a meeting place. Then add a short follow-up or reason. This builds the skill to make a simple arrangement with a time, place, and plan.
content_sections.title: Build a useful turn (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Partner A begins a realistic exchange about arranging a meeting place. Partner B asks for one missing detail. Swap roles and make one change to the time, place, reason, quantity, or next action. Check that the exchange achieves: Make a simple arrangement with a time, place, and plan.
content_sections.title: Guided dialogue (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Create a short message about arranging a meeting place without reading the model. Include a main event or plan and one precise detail. Speak it once slowly, then once at a natural pace. Listen for whether the key information is clear.
content_sections.title: Independent response (6 minutes)
